english.title: To procure a civil partnership between a child and another falsely forbid the issue of a document
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) forbade the issue of a document, namely

(A)_[a civil partnership schedule]_
(B)_[a Registrar General's licence under Chapter 1 of the Civil Partnership Act 2004]_
(C)_[a document required by an Order in Council under section 210 of the Civil Partnership Act 2004 as an authority for two people to register as civil partners]_
(D)_[a document required by an Order in Council under section 211 of the Civil Partnership Act 2004 as an authority for two people to register as civil partners]_

by representing yourself to be a person whose consent to a civil partnership between a child, namely **(..SPECIFY THE CHILD'S NAME..) and another person, namely **(..SPECIFY THE NAME..) was required under

(E)_[Part 2]_
(F)_[Part 5]_

of the Civil Partnership Act 2004, knowing the representation to be false
english.legislation: Contrary to section 80(1)(c) and 80(3) of the Civil Partnership Act 2004.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
forbid the issue of a document
falsely representing yourself
as consenting to civil partnership between child and another
